# Version 4.151.0
> **Faster raster and text paths** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap rendering performance and reduces overhead in color and text operations. The Skia m151 release also adds span-based parsing, fixes intermediate image cleanup and aligns WebAssembly native libraries with .NET 11.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remove whitespace after the color prefix** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse now reject whitespace immediately after '#' in six- and eight-digit input. Remove that whitespace before parsing; case-insensitive hexadecimal input and surrounding whitespace remain supported. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia m151** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 151 without changing the existing C API or managed binding surface in the engine update. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Parse directly from spans** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor.Parse/TryParse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, avoiding substring creation and unnecessary parsing work. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU bitmap drawing performance restored** — Restores the optimized shader-context path for scaled and tiled CPU bitmap draws, addressing high CPU use, dropped frames and flicker in affected canvas applications. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **Ganesh stencil and resolve handling** — Corrects stencil-clear coordinates, ensures stencil is cleared when preserving contents, and unwinds dirty tracking when a resolve task fails. ([#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **Malformed native text cleanup** — Corrects destruction ordering when corrupt Slug data fails to deserialize, avoiding reads and frees through already released backing memory. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Prompt subset-image cleanup** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) disposes the intermediate full image when Subset returns a different instance, while preserving same-instance results and decoded pixels. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Lower color and shaping overhead** — Moves single-color conversion and premultiplication math into managed code with native-equivalent results. SKShaper reads glyph buffers through zero-copy spans instead of allocating two temporary arrays. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Platform

- **Matching .NET 11 WebAssembly libraries** — Ships Emscripten 5.0.6 variants for .NET 11 and compiles them with the new exception-handling model, correcting link failures and browser startup failures. .NET 8, 9 and 10 keep their existing native mappings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

SkiaSharp.HarfBuzz 4.151.0 depends on HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1. The span-based Tag.Parse overload collected in this development line first shipped in HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102, co-shipped with SkiaSharp 4.151.2; it is not present in 4.151.0's default dependency.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Restored CPU bitmap performance, optimized single-color math and corrected subset-image cleanup. Added matching .NET 11 WebAssembly libraries and exception handling, plus Ganesh stencil and resolve fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Added span-based color and tag parsing, reduced shaping allocations and corrected malformed native text cleanup. Color parsing now rejects whitespace immediately after '#'.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (July 2, 2026)

Opened the Skia m151 line without changes to the managed binding surface from the engine update.
